alex (devex): Quick sync: propose we lock exact env var names and ship a tiny `rw migrate-keys` helper to reduce onboarding friction. Key goals: predictable precedence, no accidental key picking, and an opt-in migration path.

rina (sdk): Agreed. Can you list the names? We've had bugs where SDKs picked up any *_KEY var.

alex (devex): Canonical list (highest -> lowest):
1) REDWOOD_TOKEN (short-lived bearer)
2) REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY (scoped service key)
3) REDWOOD_PROJECT_TOKEN (paired with REDWOOD_DEFAULT_PROJECT)
4) RW_API_KEY (deprecated fallback, warn)
If multiple present, pick the earlier one in the list.

omar (cli): CLI behavior: if REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY exists, treat as non-interactive and skip browser flow. If none, `rw login` opens browser and writes `~/.redwood/credentials` with JSON metadata {source, expires_at, scopes}. CLI will also support `rw login --create-service --scope org:proj`.

tara (security): Ephemeral tokens must carry `aud` and `scope` claims; service keys must have `kid` and be aud-limited. Also require audit event on service key creation.

rina (sdk): SDK parity: JS/Py/Go will expose `Credentials.from_env()` and `Credentials.source` string so apps can decide to auto-refresh. Add `REDWOOD_AUTH_DEBUG=1` to surface which source was chosen (no secrets printed).

alex (devex): Migration helper: `rw migrate-keys --from RW_API_KEY --to REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY --project proj-xyz --dry-run`. It will call Console API, create scoped key, and print CI-friendly export lines. We'll include `--rotate` to schedule rotation.

tara (security): Rotation defaults: service keys TTL 90d, recommend rotate every 30d. Enterprise plan: require HSM-backed keys.

omar (cli): We'll add CLI lint that warns if RW_API_KEY is set and suggest migrate command. Lint code: `cli.auth.deprecated_env`.

rina (sdk): Tests: auth_priority.test matrix across env combos, plus a Windows-case-insensitivity test. Also integration test that `from_env().source` is correct.

migrate-bot: Note: migration window for org-99 opens in 20 days. Console: https://console.redwood.ai/migrate/org-99

alex (devex): I'll open RFC with examples for sample apps and CI. If no objections, we'll start shipping warnings next week.

rina (sdk): LGTM.

tara (security): Will review RFC for token claims.

omar (cli): I'll add the migrate flag and the lint.
